segments.en: Hello, everyone and welcome back to another lesson here at EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 Englishpod 的另一节课。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: Katerina And my name is Katerina and today we're talking about a topic very close to my heart, music.
segments.zh: Katerina：我叫 Katerina，今天我们聊一个非常贴近我内心的话题——音乐。

segments.en: Marco That's right.
segments.zh: 马可 没错。

segments.en: We're going to be talking about music and more specifically, we are going to talk about musical instruments that you would use in a band.
segments.zh: 我们要聊音乐，更具体地说，是聊乐队里会用到的乐器。

segments.en: Katerina All right.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜 好吧。

segments.en: And so some people like to make their own music, get together, hang out, play music together, so that's what we're talking about today.
segments.zh: 有些人喜欢自己做音乐，聚在一起，一起玩音乐，这就是我们今天要聊的。

segments.en: We've got a new band that's going to start and before we get going, we've got a word to talk about and let's check this out in today's vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 我们有一个新的乐队即将开始，在我们开始之前，我们有一个词要谈，让我们在今天的词汇预览中看看这一点。

segments.en: Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 词汇预览。

segments.en: Marco All right.
segments.zh: Marco，好吧。

segments.en: So as I mentioned, we are going to talk about instruments.
segments.zh: 正如我提到的，我们要聊的是乐器。

segments.en: Katerina Instruments.
segments.zh: Katerina：乐器。

segments.en: So you could say musical instruments, but what is an instrument generally speaking?
segments.zh: 所以你可以说乐器，但一般来说什么是乐器？

segments.en: Marco Basically, it's similar to a tool, right?
segments.zh: Marco 基本上，它类似于一个工具，对吧？

segments.en: So an instrument is something that you use to help you realize a task.
segments.zh: 所以 instrument 就是你用来完成某项任务的工具。

segments.en: In this case, musical instruments is more specific, right?
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，乐器就更具体了，对吧？

segments.en: Katerina Right.
segments.zh: Katerina，对。

segments.en: So we're talking about things that you use to make music.
segments.zh: 所以我们说的是用来演奏音乐的东西。

segments.en: A piano for example.
segments.zh: 以钢琴为例。

segments.en: Marco Is a musical instrument.
segments.zh: Marco：它是一种乐器。

segments.en: Katerina Or the drums.
segments.zh: Katerina：或者鼓。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this is what we're going to be looking at today in the dialogues.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们今天在对话中要看到的。

segments.en: So let's listen to it for the first time.
segments.zh: 所以让我们第一次听它。

segments.en: Katerina I'm forming a music band.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：我正在组建一支乐队。

segments.en: Marco Do you already know how to play an instrument?
segments.zh: 马可：你已经会演奏乐器了吗？

segments.en: Katerina Uh, yeah.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：呃，会啊。

segments.en: I told you a thousand times that I'm learning to play the drums.
segments.zh: 我告诉你一千次，我正在学习打鼓。

segments.en: Now that I know how to play well, I would like to form a rock band.
segments.zh: 现在我知道如何演奏好了，我想组建一支摇滚乐队。

segments.en: Marco Aside from yourself, who are the other members of the band?
segments.zh: 马可：除了你之外，乐队还有哪些成员？

segments.en: Katerina We have a guy who plays guitar and another who plays bass.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：有一个弹吉他的，还有一个弹贝斯的。

segments.en: Although we still haven't found anyone to be our singer.
segments.zh: 不过我们还没找到人来当主唱。

segments.en: You told me that you had some musical talent, right?
segments.zh: 你告诉我你有一些音乐天赋，对吧？

segments.en: Marco Yes, I'm a singer.
segments.zh: 马可：会啊，我会唱歌。

segments.en: Katerina Perfect.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：太好了。

segments.en: So you can audition this weekend here at my house.
segments.zh: 那这周末你就来我家试唱吧。

segments.en: Marco Great.
segments.zh: 马可：太好了。

segments.en: Wait, here?
segments.zh: 等等，在这里？

segments.en: You don't have enough room for the amplifiers, microphones, or even your drums.
segments.zh: 你根本没地方放放大器、麦克风，甚至你自己的鼓。

segments.en: By the way, where do you keep them or practice?
segments.zh: 对了，你把它们放哪儿，又在哪儿练啊？

segments.en: Katerina Dude, what are you talking about?
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：哥们，你在说什么呢？

segments.en: It's right here.
segments.zh: 就在这里。

segments.en: All we need is my Nintendo Wii and we're set.
segments.zh: 我们只需要我的任天堂 Wii，我们就准备好了。

segments.en: Marco All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 马可 好吧，我们回来了。

segments.en: So apparently the band wasn't really a real band.
segments.zh: 所以显然乐队并不是真正的乐队。

segments.en: Katerina It wasn't, but I have to say I'm very familiar with this because I have a Nintendo Wii and I often play the game Rock Band so I can sympathize with the characters.
segments.zh: Katerina：不算，但我得说我对这个太熟了，因为我也有任天堂 Wii，经常玩《摇滚乐队》这个游戏，所以我很能理解那些角色。

segments.en: Marco So you also have your own band?
segments.zh: Marco 所以你也有自己的乐队？

segments.en: Katerina I do.
segments.zh: Katerina：有啊。

segments.en: Well, virtually speaking.
segments.zh: 呃，是虚拟的啦。

segments.en: Marco Virtually.
segments.zh: Marco：虚拟的。

segments.en: Katerina And I know you do too.
segments.zh: Katerina：我知道你也是。

segments.en: Marco I do too.
segments.zh: 马可我也是。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We are both fans of this game and this gaming console and that's why it's such a fun dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们都是这款游戏和这款游戏机的粉丝，这就是为什么它是如此有趣的对话。

segments.en: But let's take a look at some of the language that was used in this dialogue in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 但是让我们来看看在语言要点中这种对话中使用的一些表达。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Katerina Oh man, so I've been in a lot of bands and I've been in a lot of musical groups so I can say that the first instrument we want to talk about is maybe the most obnoxious, the most loud and hard to listen to.
segments.zh: Katerina 哦，伙计，所以我参加了很多乐队，我参加过很多音乐团体，所以我可以说我们想谈论的第一个乐器可能是最令人讨厌、最响亮、最难听的乐器。

segments.en: Marco Probably, probably.
segments.zh: 马可大概，大概吧。

segments.en: And that instrument is the drums.
segments.zh: 而那个乐器就是鼓。

segments.en: So the drums, it's plural because you have many drums, right?
segments.zh: 所以鼓，它是复数的，因为你有很多鼓，对吧？

segments.en: Katerina Right.
segments.zh: Katerina，对。

segments.en: You don't just have the dum-dum-dum-dum, the bass drum.
segments.zh: 你不只有一个咚咚咚响的低音大鼓。

segments.en: You have many different drums together and so we could also call this a drum set.
segments.zh: 你有许多不同的鼓凑在一起，所以我们也可以管它叫 drum set（架子鼓）。

segments.en: Marco A drum set.
segments.zh: Marco：Drum set，架子鼓。

segments.en: All right, so why don't we listen to an example of what a drum set sounds like.
segments.zh: 好，那我们不如来听一段架子鼓的声音示例。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So I think that's clear.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这很清楚。

segments.en: Moving on to our next instrument.
segments.zh: 继续我们的下一个乐器。

segments.en: Katerina This one's maybe the most popular for young people to start because you can play pretty much anything with it and it's also good for sing-alongs.
segments.zh: Katerina：这个可能是年轻人入门最热门的乐器，因为用它几乎什么都能弹，也很适合大家一起唱。

segments.en: Marco Right, and that instrument is the guitar.
segments.zh: Marco：对，那个乐器就是吉他。

segments.en: Katerina Can you play the guitar?
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜 你会弹吉他吗？

segments.en: Marco No, I can't.
segments.zh: Marco：不，我不会。

segments.en: I actually wish I would have learned but I never got around to it.
segments.zh: 其实我挺希望自己学过的，但一直没腾出空来学。

segments.en: Katerina Well, this is a really beautiful instrument and there are many different ways to play it but generally, it's either wooden with some strings or electric so it's plastic with some metal strings.
segments.zh: Katerina：嗯，这是一种很漂亮的乐器，演奏方式有很多，但一般来说，要么是木头的，带几根琴弦，要么是电吉他，塑料琴身配金属琴弦。

segments.en: Marco Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 马可，没错。

segments.en: So they have a different sound but why don't we listen to an example of what a guitar sounds like.
segments.zh: 它们的声音不一样，我们不如来听一段吉他的声音示例。

segments.en: All right, so great example of a guitar, pretty clear.
segments.zh: 好吧，吉他的好例子，非常清楚。

segments.en: What's our next instrument?
segments.zh: 我们的下一个乐器是什么？

segments.en: Katerina The bass and this one, it doesn't look like the word that's written, B-A-S-S, so we say bass.
segments.zh: Katerina：接下来是 bass，这个词的拼写和读音对不上，它写作 B-A-S-S，但要读作 bass。

segments.en: And it's actually a very low instrument.
segments.zh: 它其实是一种音很低的乐器。

segments.en: It's usually used to help keep the rhythm.
segments.zh: 它通常用于帮助保持节奏。

segments.en: Marco All right, so it's similar to a guitar, right?
segments.zh: Marco 好吧，所以它类似于吉他，对吧？

segments.en: Katerina Very.
segments.zh: Katerina：非常像。

segments.en: Marco It's the same form but as you say, it's lower and it makes a lower sound.
segments.zh: 马可是相同的形式，但正如你所说，它更低，发出更低的声音。

segments.en: Katerina Exactly.
segments.zh: Katerina，没错。

segments.en: Marco All right, so let's listen to an example of a bass now.
segments.zh: Marco 好吧，让我们现在听一个贝司的例子。

segments.en: All right, pretty clear.
segments.zh: 好吧，很清楚。

segments.en: Moving on to our next word, we have an amplifier.
segments.zh: 继续我们的下一个词，我们有一个放大器。

segments.en: Katerina Okay, so amplifier, an amplifier is a thing.
segments.zh: Katerina：好，那么 amplifier，它是一种设备。

segments.en: It's usually a box that we plug in, it's electric or it's electronic and it's a tool to make electrical instruments like the electric guitar or the electric bass louder.
segments.zh: 它通常是一个要插电的盒子，用电的、电子的，是一种把电吉他或电贝司这类电声乐器声音放大的设备。

segments.en: Marco Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 马可，没错。

segments.en: So an amplifier is any device that makes a sound become louder.
segments.zh: 因此，放大器是任何使声音变得更响亮的设备。

segments.en: Katerina Exactly.
segments.zh: Katerina，没错。

segments.en: Marco All right.
segments.zh: Marco，好吧。

segments.en: Katerina So this is really important for rock bands the world over.
segments.zh: Katerina 所以这对世界各地的摇滚乐队来说非常重要。

segments.en: Marco Very good.
segments.zh: 马可非常好。

segments.en: Our next instrument or actually more of a tool is very useful for the singer.
segments.zh: 我们的下一个与其说是乐器，不如说更像个工具，对歌手非常有用。

segments.en: Katerina Yeah, and it actually goes with the amplifier in many ways because the microphone, this is our next word, the microphone is something that you use to sing into to make your voice louder.
segments.zh: Katerina 是的，它实际上在很多方面都与放大器一起使用，因为麦克风，这是我们的下一个词，麦克风是你用来唱的东西，让你的声音更响亮。

segments.en: So right now, Marco, you and I are both using microphones.
segments.zh: 所以现在，马可，你和我都在使用麦克风。

segments.en: Marco Exactly.
segments.zh: 马可确切地说。

segments.en: So a microphone.
segments.zh: 所以麦克风。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And we have one last word and this is a verb, to audition.
segments.zh: 我们还有最后一个词，是个动词——audition，试镜。

segments.en: Katerina All right, to audition.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜 好吧，去试镜。

segments.en: So to audition means to show someone your talent, all right?
segments.zh: 所以试镜意味着向某人展示你的才华，好吗？

segments.en: So oftentimes when you start a play or an opera or a musical group, you want to have auditions.
segments.zh: 所以当你组建剧团、歌剧团或乐队时，通常都要试镜。

segments.en: You want to audition people to see how much talent they have.
segments.zh: 你要试听这些人，看看他们有多少天赋。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So it's basically an opportunity to demonstrate your skills and abilities.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上是一个展示你的技能和能力的机会。

segments.en: Katerina Exactly.
segments.zh: Katerina，没错。

segments.en: Marco So a job interview wouldn't really be an audition.
segments.zh: 马可，所以工作面试不会是真正的试镜。

segments.en: Katerina No, a job interview has its own word.
segments.zh: Katerina：不，求职面试有它自己的说法。

segments.en: But here we're talking about your singing ability, your acting ability, your reading ability and sometimes we even have auditions here at EnglishPod to see how comfortable people are on the microphone.
segments.zh: 但在这里，我们谈论的是你的歌唱能力、你的表演能力、你的阅读能力，有时我们甚至在 Englishpod 进行试镜，看看人们在麦克风上的舒适程度。

segments.en: It's a way to have people show what they've got.
segments.zh: 就是让人们展示自己本事的一种方式。

segments.en: Marco Very good.
segments.zh: 马可非常好。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of interesting words here, many instruments.
segments.zh: 所以这里有很多有趣的词，很多乐器。

segments.en: I think it's time for us to listen to our dialogue again.
segments.zh: 我认为是时候让我们再次聆听我们的对话了。

segments.en: We're going to slow it down a little bit and we'll be right back.
segments.zh: 我们会稍微放慢速度，我们会马上回来的。

segments.en: Katerina I'm forming a music band.
segments.zh: Katerina 我正在组建一个乐队。

segments.en: Marco Do you already know how to play an instrument?
segments.zh: 马可：你已经会演奏乐器了吗？

segments.en: Katerina Yeah, I told you a thousand times that I'm learning to play the drums.
segments.zh: Katerina 是的，我告诉过你一千次，我正在学习打鼓。

segments.en: Now that I know how to play well, I would like to form a rock band.
segments.zh: 现在我知道如何演奏好了，我想组建一支摇滚乐队。

segments.en: Marco Aside from yourself, who are the other members of the band?
segments.zh: 马可：除了你之外，乐队还有哪些成员？

segments.en: Katerina We have a guy who plays guitar and another who plays bass.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：有一个弹吉他的，还有一个弹贝斯的。

segments.en: Although we still haven't found anyone to be our singer.
segments.zh: 不过我们还没找到人来当主唱。

segments.en: You told me that you had some musical talent, right?
segments.zh: 你告诉我你有一些音乐天赋，对吧？

segments.en: Marco Yes, I'm a singer.
segments.zh: 马可 是的，我是歌手。

segments.en: Katerina Perfect.
segments.zh: Katerina：太好了。

segments.en: So you can audition this weekend here at my house.
segments.zh: 那这周末你就来我家试唱吧。

segments.en: Marco Great.
segments.zh: Marco：太好了。

segments.en: Wait here.
segments.zh: 等等，就在这儿？

segments.en: You don't have enough room for the amplifiers, microphones or even your drums.
segments.zh: 你没有足够的空间放放大器、麦克风，甚至你的鼓。

segments.en: By the way, where do you keep them or practice?
segments.zh: 对了，你把它们放哪儿，又在哪儿练啊？

segments.en: Katerina Dude, what are you talking about?
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：哥们，你在说什么呢？

segments.en: It's right here.
segments.zh: 就在这里。

segments.en: All we need is my Nintendo Wii and we're set.
segments.zh: 我们只需要我的任天堂 Wii，我们就准备好了。

segments.en: Stan Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 斯坦 好吧，我们回来了。

segments.en: So moving on with our lesson, why don't we take a look now at some phrases in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以继续我们的课程，我们为什么不现在看一下流利表达中的一些短语。

segments.en: Katerina Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: Katerina：流利表达。

segments.en: Stan Alright, so on Fluency Builder we have four phrases.
segments.zh: Stan 好吧，所以我们有四个短语。

segments.en: What's the first one?
segments.zh: 第一个是什么？

segments.en: Katerina Well, this first phrase is really important, Marco, because we're talking about bands and starting bands.
segments.zh: Katerina：嗯，这第一个短语真的很重要，Marco，因为我们聊的是乐队，还有组建乐队。

segments.en: And so there's often a phrase we use to describe this.
segments.zh: 所以我们经常用一个短语来描述这一点。

segments.en: We say to form a band.
segments.zh: 我们说要组建一个乐队。

segments.en: Stan Alright, so you form a band.
segments.zh: 斯坦 好吧，所以你组建了一个乐队。

segments.en: Katerina It's like forming something.
segments.zh: Katerina：就像塑造某个东西。

segments.en: To form is to shape it, to make it look like something that you want.
segments.zh: form 就是塑造它，把它做成你想要的样子。

segments.en: And so we can form artistic projects also.
segments.zh: 所以我们也可以组建艺术项目。

segments.en: But here we're forming a band.
segments.zh: 但在这里，我们正在组建一个乐队。

segments.en: We're choosing people to bring together to make great music.
segments.zh: 我们选择人们聚集在一起制作出色的音乐。

segments.en: Stan Alright, so we can say form a band or you can say as well, start a band.
segments.zh: Stan：好，所以我们可以说 form a band，也可以说 start a band。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we're forming a band and well, his friend was surprised that the other guy knew how to play an instrument.
segments.zh: 所以我们正在组建一个乐队，他的朋友很惊讶另一个人会演奏乐器。

segments.en: So he said, I've told you a thousand times.
segments.zh: 所以他说，我已经告诉过你一千次了。

segments.en: Katerina Wait, wait.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜 等等，等等。

segments.en: So he told him one thousand times.
segments.zh: 于是他告诉他一千次。

segments.en: Stan No, not literally.
segments.zh: 斯坦不，不是字面意思。

segments.en: Katerina I play an instrument.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜 我演奏乐器。

segments.en: I play an instrument.
segments.zh: 我演奏乐器。

segments.en: I play an instrument.
segments.zh: 我演奏乐器。

segments.en: Stan Right.
segments.zh: 斯坦对。

segments.en: This is a phrase and it's a little bit of an exaggeration to emphasize that I've told you many, many times already.
segments.zh: 这是个短语，有点夸张，用来强调我已经告诉过你很多很多次了。

segments.en: Katerina Great.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜很棒。

segments.en: So this is something we say when we're trying to exaggerate like Marco said or to really emphasize the point that like I've told you this before.
segments.zh: 所以当我们想夸张一点，或者想强调“这事我以前就告诉过你”时，就会这么说。

segments.en: So mothers often use it.
segments.zh: 所以妈妈们经常使用它。

segments.en: I feel like we talk about mothers a lot here.
segments.zh: 我觉得我们在这里经常谈论母亲。

segments.en: Mothers often use this phrase when kids do something wrong.
segments.zh: 当孩子做错事时，母亲经常使用这句话。

segments.en: They say, I've told you a thousand times not to wear your shoes in the house.
segments.zh: 他们说，我告诉过你一千次不要在家里穿鞋。

segments.en: Stan Exactly.
segments.zh: 斯坦正好。

segments.en: So it is a great phrase to really make your point that you've said something many, many times.
segments.zh: 所以这是个很好用的短语，能强调你确实说过很多很多次了。

segments.en: Moving on, we have a kind of like a conjunction that you can use and it's by the way to change the topic maybe.
segments.zh: 接下来这个有点像连词，可以用来转换话题，它就是 by the way。

segments.en: By the way.
segments.zh: 顺便说一句。

segments.en: Katerina By the way.
segments.zh: Katerina：By the way。

segments.en: And so by the way, we keep these words together.
segments.zh: by the way 这几个词是固定搭配。

segments.en: It's a fixed phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个固定的短语。

segments.en: By the way is something we add on.
segments.zh: by the way 是我们额外加上去的一句话。

segments.en: So I say, you know, today I went to school and I saw a lot of people.
segments.zh: 所以我说，你知道，今天我去了学校，看到了很多人。

segments.en: Oh, by the way, John says hi.
segments.zh: 哦，顺便说一句，约翰打招呼。

segments.en: All right, so while I'm talking about this, I want to add that this thing happened or that this person said something.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以当我谈论这个时，我想补充一点，这件事发生了，或者这个人说了什么。

segments.en: Stan Exactly.
segments.zh: 斯坦正好。

segments.en: So it is, it's a conjunction, right, to put together two different ideas.
segments.zh: 所以它是个连接词，对吧，把两个不同的想法连起来。

segments.en: By the way, or you can start off your sentence with it.
segments.zh: 顺便说一句，或者你可以用它开始你的句子。

segments.en: By the way, how is the new house?
segments.zh: 顺便问一下，新房子怎么样？

segments.en: Katerina Oh, because it's like, it's like saying, oh, this thought just came into my head.
segments.zh: Katerina 哦，因为这就像，就像说，哦，这个想法刚刚出现在我的脑海中。

segments.en: By the way.
segments.zh: 顺便说一句。

segments.en: Stan Right, right.
segments.zh: 斯坦对，对。

segments.en: And our last phrase on Fluency Builder is we are set.
segments.zh: 流利表达的最后一个短语是 we are set，一切就绪。

segments.en: Katerina All right, all we need is my Nintendo Wii and we are set.
segments.zh: Katerina 好吧，我们只需要我的 Nintendo Wii，我们就准备好了。

segments.en: Stan All right, so what are we set?
segments.zh: Stan：好，那 we are set 是什么意思呢？

segments.en: We are set.
segments.zh: We are set，一切就绪。

segments.en: Katerina All right, we are set is another one of those phrases that's fixed and it literally it means and we are ready to start.
segments.zh: Katerina：好，we are set 也是一个固定短语，字面意思就是我们准备开始了。

segments.en: We're ready to go.
segments.zh: 我们准备出发。

segments.en: Stan And everything is ready.
segments.zh: 斯坦，一切都准备好了。

segments.en: Katerina Yeah, we don't need anything else.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜 是的，我们不需要其他任何东西。

segments.en: And so Marco, I could say to you, just bring, just bring the salad to the table and we're set.
segments.zh: 所以马可，我可以对你说，把沙拉带到餐桌上，我们就准备好了。

segments.en: We're ready to eat.
segments.zh: 我们准备吃饭了。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And I think we're set to listen to our dialogue for the last time.
segments.zh: 我认为我们准备最后一次听我们的对话。

segments.en: And we'll be right back and talk a little bit more about this great topic.
segments.zh: 我们会马上回来，多谈谈这个伟大的话题。

segments.en: I'm forming a music band.
segments.zh: 我正在组建一个音乐乐队。

segments.en: Do you already know how to play an instrument?
segments.zh: 你已经知道如何演奏乐器了吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I told you a thousand times that I'm learning to play the drums.
segments.zh: 是的，我告诉过你一千次，我正在学习打鼓。

segments.en: Now that I know how to play well, I would like to form a rock band.
segments.zh: 现在我知道如何演奏好了，我想组建一支摇滚乐队。

segments.en: Aside from yourself, who are the other members of the band?
segments.zh: 除了你自己，乐队的其他成员是谁？

segments.en: We have a guy who plays guitar and another who plays bass.
segments.zh: 我们有一个弹吉他的人，另一个弹贝斯的人。

segments.en: Although we still haven't found anyone to be our singer.
segments.zh: 不过我们还没找到人来当主唱。

segments.en: You told me that you had some musical talent, right?
segments.zh: 你告诉我你有一些音乐天赋，对吧？

segments.en: Yes, I'm a singer.
segments.zh: 是的，我是一名歌手。

segments.en: Perfect.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: So you can audition this weekend here at my house.
segments.zh: 那这周末你就来我家试唱吧。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Wait here.
segments.zh: 等等，就在这儿？

segments.en: You don't have enough room for the amplifiers, microphones or even your drums.
segments.zh: 你没有足够的空间放放大器、麦克风，甚至你的鼓。

segments.en: By the way, where do you keep them or practice?
segments.zh: 对了，你把它们放哪儿，又在哪儿练啊？

segments.en: Dude, what are you talking about?
segments.zh: 哥们，你在说什么？

segments.en: It's right here.
segments.zh: 就在这里。

segments.en: All we need is my Nintendo Wii and we're set.
segments.zh: 我们只需要我的任天堂 Wii，我们就准备好了。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So rock band now.
segments.zh: 所以现在摇滚乐队。

segments.en: I know that you play a real instrument, not only instruments on the Wii.
segments.zh: 我知道你演奏真正的乐器，而不仅仅是Wii上的乐器。

segments.en: True.
segments.zh: 确实。

segments.en: What do you play?
segments.zh: 你演奏什么乐器？

segments.en: I play the trumpet.
segments.zh: 我吹小号。

segments.en: I was classically trained.
segments.zh: 我受过古典音乐训练。

segments.en: I started when I was 10.
segments.zh: 我从10岁开始。

segments.en: Now is this the trumpet that has the three buttons on the top?
segments.zh: 你说的是顶上那三个键的那种小号吗？

segments.en: Yes, three pistons.
segments.zh: 是的，三个活塞。

segments.en: Three pistons.
segments.zh: 三个活塞。

segments.en: Because there's another one that doesn't, right?
segments.zh: 因为还有一种没有，对吧？

segments.en: There's one that has four pistons.
segments.zh: 有一种有四个活塞。

segments.en: It's a piccolo trumpet, has four.
segments.zh: 那是高音小号，有四个活塞。

segments.en: And there's one that's large and it slides in and out and that's a trombone.
segments.zh: 还有一种很大、能来回伸缩的，那是长号。

segments.en: That's much lower.
segments.zh: 那要低得多。

segments.en: Right, right.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: But the trumpet is kind of a mid-range instrument.
segments.zh: 但小号是中音区乐器。

segments.en: It can go quite high and a little bit low.
segments.zh: 它可以很高，有点低。

segments.en: And it's brass, it's not wood.
segments.zh: 它是黄铜做的，不是木头。

segments.en: It's made of a metal.
segments.zh: 它是由金属制成的。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It looks like gold, right?
segments.zh: 看起来像黄金，对吧？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Alright, so you play the trumpet.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你吹小号。

segments.en: Did you play in a band or in a school or college?
segments.zh: 你是在乐队还是在学校或大学里演奏？

segments.en: In middle school and high school, I played in bands and orchestras.
segments.zh: 在中学和高中，我在乐队和管弦乐队演奏。

segments.en: And in college, I played in orchestra and I've also played in rock bands because sometimes people want to, you know...
segments.zh: 在大学里，我在管弦乐队演奏，也玩过摇滚乐队，因为有时候人们会想要，你知道……

segments.en: Have a trumpet in the background.
segments.zh: 在背景里加个小号。

segments.en: Have a trumpet and go a little crazy.
segments.zh: 加个小号，玩点疯狂的。

segments.en: Nice.
segments.zh: 不错。

segments.en: Interesting.
segments.zh: 有意思。

segments.en: This is interesting because I'm sure a lot of our users out there actually play instruments and maybe a lot of them are also good at it.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，因为我敢肯定我们的很多用户实际上都在演奏乐器，也许他们中的很多人也很擅长。

segments.zh: 因此，请访问 Englishpod.com，留下您的问题和评论，让我们知道您是否演奏任何乐器或一些奇怪的乐器，如木琴。

segments.zh: 或者如果你也喜欢玩 Wii 的 Rock Band，因为我们当然也玩，这方面我们支持你。

segments.zh: 我们可以给你一些提示。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.zh: 好吧，我们会在那里见到你们。
